title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: Official PhilGEPS public category listings and six selected notice abstracts were checked successfully. Official UNGM public search returned 15 unique active notices; several notice detail requests were rate-limited with HTTP 429, so only fields actually returned by UNGM are reported. No login, CAPTCHA, MFA, paywall, or restricted document was bypassed.

urgent_deadlines.procuring_entity: Sangguniang Kabataan ng Barangay San Antonio - San Pedro City, Laguna
urgent_deadlines.note: Previously reported strong technical match remains Active and unchanged. Full public bidding, eight document requests, and an unexplained three-day delivery period make a last-minute bid high risk.

Previously reported possible match remains Active and unchanged. It uses Small Value Procurement, but the public abstract only says to see the attached purchase request; the software, hardware, scanning, migration, eligibility, and submission scope remains unverified.

urgent_deadlines.deadline: September 10, 2026 7:00 PM (GMT-4), as shown on UNGM/Quantum
urgent_deadlines.note: Previously reported thematic match remains open and unchanged. It is remote and Basic-registration accessible, but Spanish-language Mexico programme context and Quantum submission burden make it impractical for AIStaff on the remaining timeline.

not_recommended.project: Professional Services for Development of an LPCC Training Module
not_recommended.procuring_entity: Ministry of Trade, Investments & Tourism - BARMM
not_recommended.reason: New PHP 670,000 Small Value Procurement notice, but the work is specialist public-policy and emergency/disaster training content rather than AIStaff's AI, software, or digital-content production scope. The public abstract supplies no TOR, eligibility, prior-experience criteria, or module acceptance requirements.

Accessible PHP 225,000 Small Value Procurement RFQ with simple documents, but it purchases three months of radio broadcasting/airtime. AIStaff is not a radio broadcaster or airtime owner, so Brandee content capability does not create a realistic direct-supplier fit.

not_recommended.project: Integrated Conference and Video System for Argao Session Hall
not_recommended.reason: The PHP 2,303,576 public bid is a hardware supply, installation, cabling, commissioning, and training package specifying Bosch, Hikvision, LG, cameras, NVR, microphones, and licenses. It is suited to an authorized AV/system-equipment integrator, not AIStaff's software and AI services.

Strong chatbot theme and remote delivery, but it is Spanish-language, Mexico-program specific, closes tomorrow, and requires a structured technical and financial submission through UNDP Quantum. Keep as urgent awareness, not a pursuit recommendation.

not_recommended.project: Provision of CRM Solution support and maintenance services for Salesforce application
not_recommended.reason: The EOI requires recognized Salesforce expertise and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud consultant certification. AIStaff's general CRM and integration capability does not satisfy that explicit qualification.

not_recommended.project: SaaS platform for technical-scientific-educational content production
not_recommended.reason: The notice remains unchanged. It is Portuguese-language, Brazil-focused, and seeks a specialized existing content-production SaaS platform for multi-country health cooperation rather than an accessible small-supplier custom build.

The listing still shows September 14, while its description says proposals were due August 24 and questions August 12. This unresolved deadline inconsistency, enterprise loan-system complexity, and In-Tend submission path make it unsuitable.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: No suitable new opportunity found today. If AIStaff wants to preserve one near-term option, contact the Municipality of Aguilar immediately for the Archiving System purchase request before deciding whether the software-only scope is feasible.

notes: PhilGEPS count is the 105 visible first-page listings across the six requested official public category pages: 20 each in Information Technology, Consulting Services, Communication Equipment and Parts, Services, and Office Equipment, plus 5 in Advertising Agency Services.
UNGM count is 15 unique active notices returned by the official public notice search across the configured AIStaff keyword set. No new or materially updated UNGM result appeared versus September 8.

Public PhilGEPS abstract pages were opened for each new plausible candidate and each relevant urgent carry-forward; source status, budget, method, deadline, duration, description, and public contact data were checked where shown.
UNGM returned complete details for some notices and HTTP 429 for several detail pages. Rate-limited notices were not promoted without verified detail fields.
No paid or restricted bid document was downloaded. PhilGEPS document-request counts were visible for some notices, but attachments were not publicly available through the abstracts used in this scan.

The Clark Social Media Marketing Services notice (Ref 13230289), yesterday's best lead, remains Active and unchanged with a September 14, 2026 5:00 PM PHT deadline; it is excluded from BEST OPPORTUNITIES today because it is neither new, updated, nor within three days of closing.
